tasks.title: Implement Mobile Responsive Design for Calculator
tasks.description:
Review and update CSS files to ensure the calculator is fully responsive on mobile devices.

Files to modify:
- src/App.css
- src/components/Calculator.css
- src/components/Button.css
- src/components/Display.css

Implementation steps:
1. Read all existing CSS files to understand current styles
2. Add media queries for mobile breakpoints (max-width: 768px for tablets, max-width: 480px for phones)
3. Ensure calculator container scales appropriately on small screens
4. Make buttons touch-friendly with minimum 44px tap targets
5. Adjust spacing, padding, and margins for mobile viewports
6. Fix any overflow issues with viewport-based units where appropriate
7. Test responsive behavior by starting dev server and taking screenshots at mobile viewport sizes (375x667 iPhone, 414x896 iPhone Plus)
8. Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/ directory
9. Review and update component tests if any component interfaces changed (unlikely for CSS-only changes)

Acceptance criteria are defined below.
acceptance_criteria: All CSS files include appropriate media queries for mobile devices
Calculator layout adapts correctly to screen widths below 768px
All buttons meet minimum 44px touch target size on mobile
No horizontal overflow on mobile viewports
Text remains readable at all screen sizes
Screenshots show proper responsive behavior at 375px and 414px widths
All existing tests continue to pass

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator is fully responsive on mobile devices.

Validation steps:
1. Run the full test suite using `npm test` to ensure no regressions
2. Start the dev server using `npm run dev`
3. Use Playwright to take screenshots at multiple mobile viewport sizes:
   - 375x667 (iPhone SE)
   - 414x896 (iPhone 11 Pro Max)
   - 360x640 (Android)
4. Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/qa/ directory
5. Visually inspect screenshots for:
   - Proper layout on small screens
   - Touch-friendly button sizes
   - No overflow or clipping
   - Readable text at all sizes
   - Appropriate spacing and margins
6. Stop the dev server
7. Report any issues found

Acceptance criteria are defined below.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots show proper responsive layout at all tested viewport sizes
No visual overflow or clipping issues detected
All interactive elements are touch-friendly (44px minimum)
Layout remains centered and properly aligned on mobile screens
